# The Seafood Bar

> > Award-winning sustainable seafood restaurant chain with locations in Amsterdam, Utrecht, and London, featuring fresh fish, oyster bars, and the Zum Barbarossa speakeasy cocktail concept.

The Seafood Bar is operated by the De Visscher family and partners with the Good Fish Foundation for zero-waste sustainable seafood practices. The restaurant group includes multiple Amsterdam locations (Spui, Van Baerlestraat, De Pijp), Utrecht, and London venues, along with the Zum Barbarossa cocktail bar concept.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable seafood
- Happy Oyster Hour
- Zum Barbarossa cocktail bar
- Amsterdam dining locations

## Restaurant Locations

- [The Seafood Bar - Award-winning Seafood Restaurant](https://theseafoodbar.com): Award-winning sustainable seafood restaurant by De Visscher family
- [Amsterdam Reservations](https://theseafoodbar.com/reservations-amsterdam): Amsterdam reservations: Van Baerlestraat, Spui & Ferdinand Bolstraat
- [Amsterdam - Spui](https://theseafoodbar.com/amsterdam-spui): Spui city center location with Happy Oyster Hour & fresh fish
- [Amsterdam - Oud-Zuid](https://theseafoodbar.com/amsterdam-oud-zuid): Oud-Zuid location on Van Baerlestraat with Happy Oyster Hour
- [Amsterdam - De Pijp](https://theseafoodbar.com/amsterdam-de-pijp-nl): De Pijp location at Ferdinand Bolstraat 32 with reservations & walk-ins
- [The Seafood Bar Utrecht](https://theseafoodbar.com/utrecht): Utrecht location at Stationsplein 22 in Hoog Catharijne
- [Visrestaurant Amsterdam (Dutch)](https://theseafoodbar.com/visrestaurant-amsterdam): Award-winning seafood restaurant with 4 Amsterdam locations
